offence_note: Manslaughter (aggravated) of former girlfriend, guilty plea
sentence_quote: the appeal as to sentence is allowed and the sentence is varied to a net sentence of five and a half years taking into account pre-trial custody
note: Global nine years restored with roughly 2:1 credit; net 5.5 years; exact credit not stated.

offence_note: Aggravated assault and assault with a weapon (stabbing)
sentence_quote: I would dismiss the appeal from conviction, grant leave to appeal the sentence, allow the appeal on sentence, and vary the sentence to a suspended sentence together with the other terms imposed by the trial judge.
note: Jail of 12 months replaced by suspended sentence; two years probation and 10-year weapons prohibition from trial terms.

offence_note: Sexual assault of unconscious man (posed touching, photographed)
sentence_quote: I therefore direct, Mr. Reyes, that you be discharged on conditions to be prescribed in a probation order.
note: Conditional discharge; no SOIRA order; surcharge $100.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: The appeal from sentence is also dismissed.
note: Seven months imprisonment in addition to one month pre-trial custody credited; sentence already served.

offence_note: Masked robbery with bear spray, uttering threats, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: With that, I agree that the term of three years is a fit sentence and that is the order of the court.
note: Three years consecutive to sentences already served; 6 months and 3 months concurrent on threats and breach.

offence_note: Eleven pharmacy robberies with imitation firearm demanding Percocet
sentence_quote: I conclude that a sentence of four years concurrent for the 11 counts of robbery is appropriate. The total sentence is therefore seven years.
note: Three years consecutive on s. 85 counts plus four years concurrent robbery; lifetime s. 109 order.

offence_note: Serious offence from 20 years earlier; type not shown
sentence_quote: we are not prepared to interfere with the sentence imposed by the trial judge.
note: Crown appeal dismissed; conditional sentence stands, length and offence not shown.

offence_note: Sexual interference with 15-year-old (other counts conditionally stayed)
sentence_quote: On the charge of sexual interference of O.H. contrary to s. 151 of the Code, which is Count 1 of the Indictment, I impose a custodial sentence of three years.
note: CSO rejected; SOIRA 20 years; s. 161 order declined.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking conviction set aside; acquittal entered
sentence_quote: we allow the appeal, set aside the conviction and enter an acquittal.
note: Prior sentence was four months jail and 18 months probation, vacated by acquittal.

offence_note: Apparent drug-facilitated sexual assault; charges not fully stated
sentence_quote: In the event, leave to appeal sentence is denied.
note: Sentence not described; offences inferred from references to assault and amnesia drug.

offence_note: Assault, robbery, weapons dangerous, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: We vary the sentence to give effect to the joint submission that had been made at the time of the guilty plea.
note: 120 days less time served for assault and robbery; 90 days less time served for other counts; conviction appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Arson of house for insurance, and failure to comply with undertaking
sentence_quote: Accordingly, I would grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal and set aside the restitution order.
note: Restitution of $40,537.50 set aside; nine months jail and 12 months probation stand.
